notes: Section-level provenance, not a compound record. Lines 678-826 were read in full, claims 1 to 16, across the p13 break at 735 and the p14 break at 814. Claim 9 names NO specific solvent: it recites only the classes Alkohole and Ketone. The briefing lists Ketone and niedere Alkohole among the class terms that are not compounds, so no solvent record is emitted from this section and the acetone, ethanol, toluene, methanol, 2-propanol, 2-butanone, water, benzene and chlorobenzene records stay with the description sections that actually name them. Claim 11 likewise names only gängige Streckmittel and oberflächenaktive Hilfsstoffe, classes with no substance named. Excluded as not compounds: the space group symbols Pna21 (and P2(1)/n, which is not printed in this section), the unit-cell dimensions and axis labels a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma of claim 6, and the infrared, Raman and X-ray powder diffraction value tables of claims 3, 4 and 5, which are numbers characterising one modification. Claim 12's mehr als 80 Gew.-% is a composition limit and was deliberately not written to purity_pct. Claims 13 to 16 are use and method-of-control claims and name no further substance.
